# Abhed

> Abhed is an on-prem, air-gap-capable agent harness by Zybuu: the agent loop, the tool contracts, the permission engine and the sandbox, as one static binary (CLI, headless mode, JSON output, JSONL RPC, and a multi-user server with a web console) plus a Go SDK. It runs on your own hardware against a model you host, records every action in an append-only replayable log, and is licensed Apache-2.0.

Key facts, each stated on https://zybuu.com/abhed/ and traceable to the repository:

- Runs where the data is: one static binary, from a laptop to an air-gapped rack, with a signed offline bundle (built, verified by signature, then installed) for the rack. No egress by default.
- Runs any model: twenty providers over three wire formats, including a model on your own GPUs through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as Ollama. Changing vendors is a line of config.
- Sandboxed by default: tiers none / process / container / vm, chosen as the strongest backend available that meets the configured minimum; it refuses to start rather than silently downgrade.
- Every action on the record: an append-only event log, replayable step by step, with every approval and refusal and who made it, exportable as OpenTelemetry traces. On the Postgres store, events are immutable by database trigger and tenants are isolated by row-level security. The default in-memory store gives neither.
- Deny rules are absolute in every permission mode; extensions may veto a tool call and can never permit one. No approver means refuse, never assume yes.
- Embeds through a Go SDK with the same loop, policy and record. The SDK builds no sandbox: the host owns isolation.
- Extend without forking: extensions (separate JSONL processes in any language), skills (a directory with a procedure), MCP servers (registered, disabled until enabled, optional tool allowlist).
- Benchmark (2026-09-14, 24 Exercism Python exercises, one local 26B model, identical prompt): Abhed 24/24, a bare tool loop 22/24, aider 0.86.2 default one-shot 19/24. Abhed was the slowest and used the most tokens; the suite is small and single-file.
- Not yet: no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA or FedRAMP certification; no support SLA; single node, no horizontal scaling or failover; Postgres is the only durable store; a human red-team engagement is outstanding; prompt injection is contained, not solved.
- Pricing (launch, September 2026): Community free and open source; Team USD 49 per seat per month, ten-seat minimum, billed yearly; Enterprise USD 60,000 per site per year plus USD 79 per seat per month, air-gapped sites add USD 25,000; design partner programme USD 25,000. Never per token.
- Status: pre-release (0.1.x), invite-only. The repository is not public yet; access is by request at https://zybuu.com/abhed/#access or support@zybuu.com.

Who it is for: platform and security teams in places with no route out — defence and intelligence contractors, sovereign and public-sector deployments, operational networks, and banks whose policy is no cloud at all. It is not the right tool for a solo developer who is happy in the cloud.

Company: Zybuu (https://zybuu.com), founded 1 September 2026, founder-led. Contact support@zybuu.com.

Documentation index: https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/

## Overview

- [Why Zybuu, and why Abhed](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/vision): The answer to the first question every buyer and every investor asks.

## Guide

Using Abhed day to day.

- [Getting started](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/01-getting-started): Abhed is a single static binary with no runtime to install.
- [Configuration](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/02-configuration): Abhed reads .abhed/config.json from the workspace.
- [Models and providers](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/03-providers): Abhed does not ship a model. It is model-agnostic by construction: the harness is the same whichever endpoint you point it at, and a better model makes the same harness better.
- [Permissions and safety](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/04-permissions): An agent that can run shell commands in your repository needs a real answer to "what is it allowed to do".
- [Tools](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/05-tools): Four routes, none of which needs a rebuild.
- [Skills](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/06-skills): A skill is a procedure Abhed should follow when a request matches it: how your team cuts a release, the checklist for a schema migration, the house format for an incident report.
- [Extensions](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/07-extensions): An extension changes how the agent behaves without forking it.
- [MCP](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/08-mcp): Abhed is an MCP client and gateway. A tool exposed by a Model Context Protocol server appears in the model's tool list like any built-in one.
- [The SDK](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/09-sdk): Abhed's internals live under internal/, which Go refuses to let another module import.
- [Automation](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/10-automation): Three ways to run Abhed without a person at the prompt.
- [Sessions and audit](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/11-sessions): Abhed's state is a chronological stream of events.
- [Observability](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/12-observability): Every session is already an ordered log of events — that is the audit trail, and it is the source of truth.
- [Structured output](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/13-structured-output): A program embedding Abhed usually does not want prose.
- [Parallel subagents and worktree isolation](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/14-parallel-subagents): The task tool runs one subagent and waits.
- [Scheduled runs](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/guide/15-schedules): A recurring run is the shape of a lot of real work: every weekday at nine, summarise what changed overnight; hourly, check the staging pods; Sunday night, run the dependency audit.

## Architecture

How it is built, and why.

- [Abhed — Design Principles](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/01-principles): Abhed is an on-prem, air-gap-capable deep agent platform.
- [Abhed — System Architecture](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/02-system-architecture): Abhed splits into four planes so the air-gap boundary falls on a single, auditable line.
- [Abhed — Execution Isolation & Prompt-Injection Defense](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/03-security): T2/T3 are the defining hazard of an agentic system.
- [Abhed — Resource Requirements & Sizing](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/04-sizing): The second line is the one that decides your cluster.
- [Abhed — Build Plan, Team & Sequencing](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/05-roadmap): The principle: build the harness, adopt everything else.
- [Abhed — Tool Contracts](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/06-tool-contracts): This is the most important document in the repo.
- [Abhed — System Prompt & Memory Design](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/07-system-prompt): The system prompt is the harness's highest-leverage artifact.
- [Abhed — Evaluation Harness](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/08-eval): Per P1, the harness is the dominant variable in agent success.
- [Abhed — CLI & Product Surface](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/09-ux): The architecture makes Abhed *work*; this document is what makes it feel like a tool an engineer wants to use.
- [Abhed — Data Model & API](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/10-data-model): The event stream is the source of truth. Sessions, audit logs, replay, and the eval harness are all projections of it.
- [Abhed — Model providers and sampling parameters](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/11-providers): Abhed's value is the harness, and a harness is only as good as the models it can drive.
- [Abhed extensions](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/15-extensions): An extension changes how the agent behaves without forking it.
- [Embedding Abhed](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/architecture/16-sdk): Everything Abhed does lives under internal/, which Go refuses to let another module import.

## Operations

Running it in a real environment.

- [Abhed — Air-Gapped Deployment & Egress Brokering](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/ops/air-gap): Abhed ships one artifact set supporting three deployment postures.
- [Abhed — Enabling Authentication](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/ops/enabling-auth): Four modes. Pick by how Abhed is exposed, not by how much security sounds good.
- [Abhed — Clusters, Machines, and External Retrieval](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/ops/infrastructure): Four capabilities that let Abhed work on infrastructure rather than only on files.
- [Abhed — Choosing a Model](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/ops/model-selection): Measured on an Apple M3 Pro, 36 GB unified memory, Ollama 0.33.2, September 2026.
- [Abhed — OIDC Provider Configuration](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/ops/oidc-providers): Verified against the real token and JWKS shapes each provider issues (internal/auth/providers_test.go).
- [Abhed — Red-Team Engagement Scope](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/ops/red-team-scope): This exists to be handed to a security firm or an internal offensive team.
- [Abhed — Skills](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/ops/skills): A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md: frontmatter naming it and saying when to use it, then instructions.

## Trust

What a security review will ask, answered from the code.

- [Backup and restore](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/trust/backup-restore): How the hosted console's data is backed up today, how to restore it, and the recovery point that gives you.
- [Data handling](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/trust/data-handling): What Abhed stores, where it lives, how long it lives, what an operator can do about it, and who else touches data for the hosted console.
- [Incident response](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/trust/incident-response): A short, honest runbook. Zybuu is a one-person company — this is what happens when there is one person, not a security operations center, and it is written that way on purpose rather than dressed up…
- [Security posture](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/trust/security-posture): A summary for a security reviewer. Every claim below names the file that makes it true — read the file if you need more than the summary.
- [Security scans](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/trust/security-scans): Independent, third-party tooling run against this repository and its container image on 2026-09-14.
- [Vulnerability disclosure policy](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/trust/vulnerability-disclosure): Questionnaire-formatted version of SECURITY.md.

## Benchmarks

Measured, reproducible, published whatever they say.

- [Method: a reproducible local benchmark](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/benchmarks/method): This directory holds a small, honest benchmark comparing three coding-agent harnesses driven by the same local model, so what's being measured is the harness, not the model:
- [Results: Abhed vs. aider vs. a bare agent loop](https://abhed.zybuu.com/docs/benchmarks/results): Model: gemma4:26b, served locally by Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434 (OpenAI-compatible endpoint), identical for all three systems.
